name: appsec-workflow
description: Combine AI reasoning with whole-program static taint analysis to find vulnerabilities and store project-specific security knowledge

interface.shortDescription: Find vulnerabilities with AI reasoning and static taint analysis
interface.longDescription: Use an AI agent to learn the application's trust boundaries and vulnerability patterns. Record this knowledge in taint rules and dependency models. OpenTaint uses the rules and models for whole-program static taint analysis. Keep the rules and models in the project for future scans.
defaultPrompt: Use the appsec-agent skill to run a deep scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a normal scan with static triage
Use the appsec-agent skill to run a lite scan with dynamic confirmation
